_about: The isnail-30 story as the storyboard page shows it: its five parts, the moments to render as previews, the hits marked on the beat grid and what the user signs off. Times are story events (story.json) plus an offset, so a film that moves an event moves its frame. {name} {handle} {counter} {slogan} {prop} {signature} {proof1} {proof2} {publish} {aspect} are filled from film.json.

what.zh-Hant: 佢 X 主頁好似螢幕咁平放填滿畫面；向右轉、退去左邊，幾條欄拆開變成企起嘅板（Kin 條片嘅開場，方向調轉）；佢個頭像鼓起，2.0 秒強拍膨出變公仔
what.zh-Hans: 他的 X 主页像屏幕一样平放填满画面；向右转、退到左边，几栏拆开变成立着的板（Kin 片子的开场，方向反过来）；他的头像鼓起，2.0 秒强拍膨出变公仔
what.en: His X page fills the frame flat like a screen; it turns right and backs off left as its columns part into standing slabs (Kin's opening, mirrored); his picture bulges and he puffs out of it on the 2.0 s downbeat

what.zh-Hant: 座枱日曆升起，「7月10日」一頁頁翻，越翻越快，旁邊關注者數由 0 升；10.0 秒停喺「10月24日」，數字鎖定 10,000，紅色「万粉」印章蓋落，落彩紙

what.zh-Hans: 他 7 月 30 日那篇帖子的封面立起做墙：「5」砸下，「天」「+」「star」、副题、标签、App 窗口逐件弹出；16.4 秒公仔指着「380」，「380」切出来变金色立体数字，跳到 1,500，18 秒锁定落金星，再落回封面撞走「5天」，墙上变「1,500+ star」
what.en: His 7/30 post's cover stands as the wall; 5 slams, the rest pops; at 16.4 s he points at 380, which turns into gold 3D digits counting to 1,500 (locks at 18 s, gold stars), then drops back, knocking 5天 off: 1,500+ star

decisions.zh-Hant: 條片而家 38 秒：四個重點用返你 10 月 26 日嘅原話（萬粉、Grok App 1,500 星、野生 → 官方大使、老馬得到佢；官方新手教程拎走咗），長度跟內容，唔再限死 30 秒。
decisions.zh-Hans: 片子现在 38 秒：四个重点用回你 10 月 26 日的原话（万粉、Grok App 1,500 星、野生 → 官方大使、老马得到他；官方新手教程拿掉了），长度跟内容，不再限死 30 秒。
decisions.en: The film is now 38 s: four of the user's points (10k, 1,500 stars, wild → official, Musk got him; the guide is out); the length follows the content.

decisions.zh-Hant: 計數器：關注者由 0 數到「10,000 关注者」，由萬粉截圖上「1万 关注者」嘅位置飛出。
